name: Leather Magnetic Bookmark with Pen Clip
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality PU leather, offering a soft touch, durable structure, and elegant everyday look.
    - Designed with strong hidden magnets to help keep the bookmark securely in place between pages.
    - Includes a practical pen clip function, making it convenient for carrying a pen together with your notebook, planner, or book.
    - The PU leather surface gives the product a classic and refined appearance while remaining lightweight and easy to use.
    - Available in 6 color variations: Blue, Brown, Red, Dark Brown, Purple, Green

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Closed size: 3.45 x 5 cm ~ 1.36 x 1.97 in
    - Opened size: 8 x 5 cm ~ 3.15 x 1.97 in
    📌 Note:  The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customize the printed design only.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vivid colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Designed with single-sided printing on the front surface.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a magnetic bookmark and a pen holder clip.
    - Suitable for books, journals, planners, notebooks, agendas, textbooks, and office documents.
    - Helps mark pages clearly while keeping a pen conveniently attached.
    - Great for reading, studying, note-taking, office work, and daily organization.
    - Lightweight and easy to carry in bags, backpacks, purses, or desk organizers.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for teachers, students, book lovers, coworkers, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, Teacher Appreciation Day, back-to-school gifts, holidays, graduation gifts, and special occasions.
    - Ideal for anyone who enjoys reading, journaling, planning, or stationery accessories.
    - Great as a practical yet stylish gift that combines daily function with a personal touch.
    - A charming accessory that adds organization and personality to everyday reading and writing ✨

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x  Leather Magnetic Bookmark with Pen Clip

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE

  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
